description: Provides housekeeping, cleaning, laundry, and kitchen-maintenance services in private households or small establishments.
Takes measurements, drafts patterns, cuts fabric and sews custom garments, including alterations.
Plans, installs, tests, and maintains electrical and electronic sub-systems and wiring; treated as informal-sector when unlicensed/self-employed.
Guards premises, people, and property, including cash-in-transit escort duties, typically employed by a private security agency.
Delivers packages or food on a two-wheeler for an e-commerce or food-delivery platform. NCO-2015 alignment REQUIRES OFFICIAL SOURCE VERIFICATION.
Performs manual labour on building and construction sites, often on a daily-wage basis. NCO-2015 alignment REQUIRES OFFICIAL SOURCE VERIFICATION.
Drives a passenger auto-rickshaw or taxi, typically self-employed or on a per-trip commission basis. NCO-2015 alignment REQUIRES OFFICIAL SOURCE VERIFICATION.
Sells goods (e.g. fruits, vegetables, small retail items) from a street stall, cart, or market pitch. NCO-2015 alignment REQUIRES OFFICIAL SOURCE VERIFICATION.

Performs fitting, assembly, and precision-measurement work in a workshop or industrial setting; a core NCVT/DGT-recognized trade offered at multiple Karnataka Government ITIs. NCO-2015 code REQUIRES OFFICIAL SOURCE VERIFICATION.
Performs arc/gas welding and metal-fabrication work; a core NCVT/DGT-recognized trade. NCO-2015 code REQUIRES OFFICIAL SOURCE VERIFICATION.

Operates lathe, milling, and other machine-shop tools to produce precision components; covers the closely-related NCVT/DGT trades Machinist and Turner, both offered at Karnataka Government ITIs. NCO-2015 code REQUIRES OFFICIAL SOURCE VERIFICATION.
Services, repairs, and maintains motor vehicles in a workshop setting; a core NCVT/DGT-recognized trade offered at a Karnataka Government ITI. NCO-2015 code REQUIRES OFFICIAL SOURCE VERIFICATION.
Services and repairs electronic equipment; a core NCVT/DGT-recognized trade (Electronics Mechanic) offered at Karnataka Government ITIs. NCO-2015 code REQUIRES OFFICIAL SOURCE VERIFICATION.
